title: New in Town: Asking About Basic Services
text:
Mia: Hello. I am new here. Are you the building manager?
Mr. Lee: Yes, I am. I am Lee. Are you from China?
Mia: Yes, I am. But I am not a student. I am a nurse.
Mr. Lee: Oh, good. Is there a hospital near here?
Mia: Yes, there is. It is not far. Who is the doctor there?
Mr. Lee: Dr. Chen. She is very nice. Are you tired?
Mia: No, I am not. Is the bus stop near the hospital?
Mr. Lee: Yes, it is. It is next to the bank. The bank is not open today.
Mia: Thank you. Are you busy now?
Mr. Lee: No, I am not. Goodbye, Mia.

questions.prompt: Is there a hospital near here?
Who is the doctor at the hospital?
Which place is next to the bus stop?
